finding.title: Log and surface the swallowed exceptions in step_starting_position.dart._loadContent and step_starting_position_calendar.dart._refreshCalendarEntry instead of silently stranding the user
finding.why: step_starting_position.dart._loadContent catches everything and only flips _loading to false — it never logs via AppLogger and never sets an error flag. Since _containers/_leaves default to [], build() falls straight through to `_buildContainerList` with an EMPTY list and no CircularProgressIndicator, no error text, and no retry action: the user lands on a blank, silently-broken 'starting position' step of the Add-Track wizard with the Continue button permanently disabled (onPressed requires _selectedLeaf != null, which can never become non-null from an empty list) and zero indication anything went wrong. step_starting_position_calendar.dart._refreshCalendarEntry has no catch at all (only `finally`) around two awaits, and every caller invokes it via `unawaited(...)`, so a thrown exception becomes an unhandled Future rejection with no AppLogger trail; the user instead sees the ALSO-hardcoded 'No local calendar entry found for this date.' fallback, which mislabels a real fetch/service failure as 'no data for this date'.
finding.recommendation: In both catches (or the missing one in the calendar file), log via AppLogger with context (curriculumId/programKey), and expose a distinct error state to the widget (e.g. an AppErrorView with retry, matching the pattern TrackManagementBody already uses via ref.watch(...).when(error: ...)) instead of silently falling through to an indistinguishable empty/fallback UI.
acceptance_criteria: Both catch paths call AppLogger.error/warning with the caught exception before updating state.
A widget test that makes the repository/service throw asserts a visible error affordance (not a blank list / not the generic 'no entry' text) appears.
EH-3's log-less-catch grep (once made a checker) passes on both files.
